findings.issue: 書斎 mistranslated as 'company' in the literal translation; 書斎 is a study/study room (as en, pt and the token gloss correctly say). Teaches a false vocabulary meaning.
findings.current: As for Dad, he got that person into the company (made them enter).
findings.suggested: As for Dad, he got that person into the study (made them enter).

findings.issue: Note on ござい gives the 連用形 of ござる as the nonsense form '(ださ)' in both the en and pt-BR versions; the correct base that takes 〜ます is ござい.
findings.current: 連用形 form (ださ) of ござる, the base for taking 〜ます / forma 連用形 (ださ) de ござる
findings.suggested: 連用形 form (ござい) of ござる, the base for taking 〜ます / forma 連用形 (ござい) de ござる

findings.issue: 'Me insistiu' is ungrammatical in Brazilian Portuguese — insistir does not take a person as direct object (would be 'insistiu comigo'). せきたてた = apressou/instou fits better.
findings.current: Meu pai me insistiu para que eu fosse junto.
findings.suggested: Meu pai me apressou para que eu fosse junto.

findings.issue: Garbled contrast name 'は…が…は' — the trailing は is spurious; the intended concept is the は…が contrast.
findings.current: so there is no は…が…は contrast in this sentence
findings.suggested: so there is no は…が contrast in this sentence

findings.issue: Same garble as expl_en: 'o contraste は…が…は' has a spurious trailing は.
findings.current: então não há o contraste は…が…は nesta frase
findings.suggested: então não há o contraste は…が nesta frase

findings.issue: '(formas estado)' is ungrammatical Portuguese — missing 'de' (mirrors en '(stative forms)').
findings.current: Com adjetivos-な (formas estado) como 元気
findings.suggested: Com adjetivos-な (formas de estado) como 元気

findings.issue: English gloss of その includes '(that one, fem.)' — the 'fem.' is Portuguese agreement leakage and wrongly implies the Japanese demonstrative has gender (compare tatoeba-84720: 'that (that one)').
